items.title: Personal income tax
items.body: No income tax on salaries, rental income, freelance fees or pensions. Applies to UAE tax residents regardless of source country (subject to treaty rules).

items.title: Capital gains
items.body: Sale of stocks, bonds, crypto and personally-held real estate by individuals is not taxable. Corporate-held assets fall under the 9% regime.

items.title: Dividends
items.body: Dividends received by UAE individuals are tax-free. Dividends paid by UAE entities are typically exempt under participation relief.

items.title: Inheritance & wealth
items.body: No estate duty, no annual wealth tax, no gift tax. Sharia rules apply unless a DIFC/ADGM will overrides — we set those up routinely.

items.title: Corporate tax
items.body: Introduced June 2023. Applies to net profits above AED 375,000 (≈ $102K). Below threshold → 0%. Free Zone Qualifying Income still 0%.

items.title: VAT
items.body: Standard rate on most goods/services. Healthcare, education, residential rentals and exports are zero-rated or exempt. Mandatory registration at AED 375K turnover.

structures.subtitle: Three legal structures, three tax outcomes. Pick by where your clients are, whether you need physical presence, and how much corporate tax you're willing to pay.

items.label: Free Zone
items.best: Software, consulting, e-commerce, holding companies — clients abroad

items.label: Mainland (DED)
items.best: Retail, restaurants, services to UAE clients, government contracts

items.label: Offshore (IBC)
items.best: Asset holding, IP licensing, international trade — not for UAE operations

residency.subtitle: Tax residency requires a residence visa plus 183 days in-country (or 90 days with stronger ties). Pick the route that matches your situation.

items.name: Golden Visa
items.body: 10-year renewable residence on $545K+ Dubai real estate, an active business with $545K+ capital, or recognised talent in science/arts/sports.

items.name: Investor Visa
items.body: 2–3 year renewable residence on $204K+ property purchase or company ownership. Sponsors immediate family. Upgradeable to Golden.

items.name: Employment visa
items.body: Sponsored by a UAE employer (mainland or free zone). Includes a labour card. Many free zones offer self-sponsorship of your own salary.

items.name: Freelance permit
items.body: Free-zone freelance permit + visa for consultants, designers, developers. Lowest entry cost — pairs well with foreign client base.

items.title: Founders & operators
items.body: You run a business with global clients. Move the operating company to a Free Zone, become tax resident, keep 91–100% of profit.

items.title: Investors & traders
items.body: Stocks, crypto, real-estate portfolio. Personal capital gains are 0%. Combine with Golden Visa to lock in residency for 10 years.

items.title: Remote professionals
items.body: High-earning consultants and engineers. Freelance permit + 183 days = 0% personal tax on global earnings, fully legal.

items.q: Is it actually legal to pay 0% income tax?
items.a: Yes. The UAE simply does not levy a personal income tax. The legality issue is on the *other* side — you need to genuinely exit tax residency in your home country (CFC rules, centre of vital interests, day-count). That's the real work, and it's what we plan with you.

items.q: What about CFC rules in my home country?
items.a: Most developed countries have Controlled Foreign Company rules that attribute the income of foreign companies back to the resident shareholder. The UAE structure must therefore have real substance: an office, employees or director presence, real decision-making in the UAE. We build the substance, not just paperwork.

items.q: How do I exit tax residency in my country?
items.a: Each country has its own rules: physical absence (Russia 183 days), centre of vital interests (Germany, France), domicile (UK). Some have exit taxes on unrealised gains (US, France, Germany). We sequence the move with your home-country tax advisor.

items.q: Will the UAE share my financial data?
items.a: Yes — under CRS (Common Reporting Standard) the UAE exchanges account information with 100+ countries. The UAE structure is not about hiding; it's about legally relocating where the tax is paid (or not paid).

items.q: Does the 9% corporate tax kill the model?
items.a: Rarely. For a Free Zone entity with Qualifying Income (most B2B services to non-UAE clients), the rate is still 0%. Even on mainland with 9%, the comparison vs 25–40% corporate tax in Europe + dividend tax is overwhelming.

Free Zone company + visa + Emirates ID + first-year compliance: $7K–15K depending on activity. Add property for Golden Visa from $545K. We give you an exact number after the discovery call — no fixed quote here would be honest.

items.q: Can my family come with me?
items.a: Yes. The primary resident sponsors spouse, children (under 18, or under 25 for students), and parents (with proof of dependence). School fees in Dubai start at $5K/yr, top international schools $25–40K.

items.q: How long until I have the TRC in hand?
items.a: Realistic timeline: company + visa in 30 days, then 183 days physical presence, then 2–6 weeks for the FTA to issue the TRC. Plan for 8–10 months from kick-off to certificate.
